description: Returns the authenticated user's current listing capabilities: whether they can create a new listing right now (subscription plan limit), whether they have a payment/shipment method configured (both required before products.create will succeed), the max images and price their plan allows (max_price null = no price cap), and their remaining AI credit balance (each draft listing costs 2 credits, charged when it is created from the uploaded photos). Call this BEFORE asking the user for photos or calling products.create, so you can tell the user upfront if something would block listing creation, instead of finding out only after a failed attempt. If the credit balance is too low, ai_credits_purchase_url is the seller's resollo.com page for buying more (translate_credits_purchase_url likewise for translation credits). Read-only, no side effects.
name: sellers.status

currency.description: The user's own currency (ISO 4217). Search, product and order tools return prices in it when you don't pass currency -- use it for price_min/price_max too.

listing_count.description: The seller's current listings counted against max_products: every non-deleted listing, inactive drafts and closed ones included.

max_images.description: Max photos per listing on the seller's plan.

max_price.description: The plan's price cap per listing; null means no cap.

payment_methods.description: Payment method codes the seller accepts (see marketplace.info), e.g. cash, card, stripe.

plan.description: Name of the seller's active subscription plan (e.g. Free, Standard, Commission); null if none is active.

plan_expires_at.description: When the active plan ends (ISO 8601); null if it has no end date (commission plan) or none is active.

shipment_methods.description: Shipment method codes the seller offers (see marketplace.info), e.g. personal, courier.

title: Get the authenticated seller's current listing status
